name: extreme-curves-split-hair-selfie
image_purpose: Alternative hairstyle post and bedroom lifestyle visual

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic bedroom mirror selfie featuring split-dyed hair and a relaxed bed pose.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with long wavy hair split half jet-black and half platinum-blonde, straight bangs, soft doe eyes, winged eyeliner, and natural skin texture. She wears a simple pink cropped tank top and secure black fitted lounge shorts, lying comfortably on a white bed while propped on her elbows and holding a pink-cased phone.
prompt.composition_elements: 9:16 eye-level mirror composition with the subject on a rumpled white bed, chin resting lightly on one hand and phone in the other, legs bent comfortably. Include neutral walls, plush pillows, soft window light, and accurate reflection of the split hair and phone case.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural lateral window daylight, gentle bedding shadows, clean domestic bedroom atmosphere, quiet alternative lifestyle mood.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution portrait photography, 9:16, realistic hair separation, skin pores, cotton and bedding texture, subtle grain, soft background falloff, no artificial smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A realistic 9:16 bedroom mirror selfie of one approved adult woman with long wavy hair split half jet-black and half platinum-blonde, straight bangs, soft doe eyes, winged eyeliner, and natural skin texture. She wears a simple pink cropped tank top and secure black fitted lounge shorts, lying comfortably on a white bed while propped on her elbows, chin resting lightly on one hand and holding a pink-cased phone in the other. Include rumpled white linens, plush pillows, neutral walls, soft lateral window daylight, accurate reflection of the split hair and phone case, realistic fabric and skin texture, subtle grain, and a quiet alternative lifestyle mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, prone erotic framing, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, broken reflection, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur
